questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements:
1. Some microorganisms can grow in environments with temperature above the boiling point of water.
2. Some microorganisms can grow in environments with temperature below the freezing point of water.
3. Some microorganisms can grow in highly acidic environments with a pH below 3.

How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanation: All three statements are correct: 1. Hyperthermophilic archaea (e.g., Methanopyrus kandleri) survive at 122°C in hydrothermal vents. 2. Psychrophilic bacteria (e.g., Planococcus halocryophilus) remain active at -15°C in permafrost. 3. Acidophilic microbes (e.g., Picrophilus oshimae) thrive at pH 0.7 in solfataric fields.
